title: Wso2am: Netty is a network application framework for development of protocol servers and clients (CVE-2026-50020)
description: A security vulnerability exists in the wso2am package related to the Netty network application framework, which is used for developing protocol servers and clients. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.3 (medium severity) and impacts versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The flaw does not affect confidentiality or availability but can cause integrity loss. A patch is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
